title: JobMatchingAnnotation
description: Schema for resume-to-job relevance annotation. PENDING IMPLEMENTATION.

_implementation_note.const: Job matching evaluation is PENDING. The current application only supports pairwise role-alignment scoring (TF-IDF cosine similarity), not top-k retrieval from a candidate pool. Ranked evaluation metrics (MRR, nDCG@k) cannot be computed until a ranked candidate set is implemented. This schema is provided for future annotation collection.
